core_cases: Set ack and 1 KiB cap; verify storage cleanup after success.
Induce QuotaExceededError; assert all temporary keys removed.
Abort probe midway; ensure cleanup; verify other localStorage keys untouched.
security_cases: Reject oversized or malicious input and control characters.
No untrusted HTML insertion: use textContent and escaped JSON/XML.
Reject unsafe URLs and paths; disallow accidental network requests.
ui_cases: On 320px viewport no horizontal page scrolling.
Tab order, visible focus ring, Enter submits, Escape/cancel where applicable.
Result is announced through aria-live; copy/download content matches generated result.
performance_cases: Large valid input stays responsive or explicitly fails within configured bounds.
